```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
source("source_qmd.R")
source_qmd("1-functions.qmd")
```

## Employer

### Characteristics

::: panel-tabset
#### 1

```{r}
#| label: emp-org-scale

employer$emp_org_scale |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$emp_org_scale |>
      str_remove_all("^.*: | -.*$")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("emp_org_scale") |>
      str_wrap(55)
  )
```

#### 2

```{r}
#| label: emp-org-typ

employer$emp_org_typ |>
  mutate(emp_org_typ = emp_org_typ |> fct_reorder(-count)) |> 
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$emp_org_typ |>
      str_remove(":.*$") |>
      str_replace("/", " / ") |>
      str_wrap(15)
  ) +
  labs(title = get_question("emp_org_typ"))
```

#### 3

```{r}
#| label: emp-org-prov

employer$emp_org_prov |>
  mutate(
    emp_org_prov = emp_org_prov |> 
      fct_reorder(-count) |> 
      fct_relevel("1", after = Inf)
  ) |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "1" = "National /\nPan-Canadian",
      "2" = "AB",
      "3" = "BC",
      "4" = "MB",
      "5" = "NB",
      "6" = "NL",
      "7" = "QC",
      "8" = "NS",
      "9" = "ON",
      "10" = "PE",
      "11" = "SK",
      "12" = "NT",
      "13" = "NU",
      "14" = "YT"
    )
  ) +
  labs(title = "Where in Canada does your organization conduct Clinical Research operations?")
```

#### 4

```{r}
#| label: emp-site

employer$emp_site |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$emp_site |>
      c("4" = "Rural/Northern") |>
      str_remove(" \\(.*\\)")
  ) +
  labs(title = get_question("emp_site"))
```

#### 5

```{r}
#| label: emp-certif

employer$emp_certif |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = choices$emp_certif |> 
      str_replace("clinical research staff.", "Clinical Research staff") |>
      str_wrap(30)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("emp_certif") |>
      str_remove(" %") |>
      str_wrap(75)
  )
```

### Barriers to recruiting qualified staff

::: panel-tabset
#### 1

```{r}
#| label: emp-sal

employer$emp_sal |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = choices$emp_sal) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("emp_sal") |>
      str_replace(": ", ":\n")
  )
```

#### 2

```{r}
#| label: emp-qual

employer$emp_qual |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = choices$emp_qual) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("emp_qual") |>
      str_replace(": ", ":\n") |>
      str_remove(" or ")
  )
```

#### 3

```{r}
#| label: emp-contr

employer$emp_contr |>
  ggplot_1() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = choices$emp_contr) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("emp_contr") |>
      str_replace(": ", ":\n") |>
      str_replace("roles", "roles\\.")
  )
```

#### 4

```{r}
#| label: emp-geo

  ggplot_1() +
```


#### 6

```{r}
#| label: emp-reput

employer$emp_reput |>
  mutate(
    emp_reput = emp_reput |>
      fct_expand("4", after = 3)
  ) |>
  ggplot_1(drop_empty = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = choices$emp_reput
  ) +
  labs(
    title = get_question("emp_reput") |>
      str_replace(": ", ":\n")
  )
```

#### 7

```{r}
#| label: barriers

employer_1 |>
  select(emp_sal:emp_reput) |>
  drop_na() |> 
  ggstats::gglikert(
    variable_labels = c(
      emp_sal = "Salary / Benefits",
      emp_qual = "Candidate Quality",
      emp_contr = "Contract Instability",
      emp_geo = "Geography",
      emp_pipe = "Internal Pipeline",
      emp_reput = "Workload Reputation"
    ),
    y_label_wrap = 15,
    sort = "ascending",
    cutoff = 1
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-0.25, 0.75, 0.25),
    labels = \(x) scales::label_percent()(abs(x))
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    option = "viridis", 
    labels = choices$emp_sal
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Barriers to recruiting qualified staff",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", n_respondents$emp_sal)
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```
:::
